crossRefs.note: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will…
He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.
marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here?’
“For this is like the waters of Noah to me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah will no more go over the earth…
Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea…

translations.web: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
translations.bsb: You set a boundary they cannot cross, that they may never again cover the earth.
translations.kjv: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
translations.asv: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; That they turn not again to cover the earth.
